title: Trevor Noah Joins Workhuman Live 2025 Speaker Lineup
htmlContent:
Trevor Noah to Speak on the Future of AI

The lineup for Workhuman Live 2025 has expanded to include Trevor Noah, an Emmy Award-winning host of The Daily Show, a bestselling author, and a comedian. Noah will be captivating the audience with his signature blend of humor and thought-provoking insights when he takes the stage on May 14, 2025. Noah, who is currently serving as Microsoft's Chief Question Officer, will discuss the transformative potential of AI and its importance in solving global challenges.

Unique Insights from a Global Perspective

Trevor Noah's presentation will incorporate his extensive personal and professional experiences, including his global engagements with technologists, engineers, and communities. The author of Born a Crime: Stories from a Southern African Childhood is well-known for his storytelling skills. Breaking down complex AI concepts into practical insights will empower attendees to apply these lessons professionally and personally.

Unique Insights from a Global Perspective

Trevor Noah's presentation will be based on his extensive personal and professional experiences, which include his worldwide interactions with technologists, engineers, and communities. As the author of the #1 New York Times bestseller Born a Crime: Stories from a Southern African Childhood, Noah is renowned for his storytelling prowess. Breaking down complex AI concepts into practical insights will allow attendees to apply these lessons professionally and personally.

A Star-Studded Speaker Lineup

Workhuman Live 2025, scheduled for May 12-15, promises to be a transformational experience for HR professionals and business leaders. The event boasts a stellar lineup of speakers:
  • Adam Grant: Renowned organizational psychologist and bestselling author, offering transformative insights on workplace culture and human potential.
  • Erin Meyer: Expert in cross-cultural communication and leadership, presenting innovative strategies for navigating global business challenges.
  • Cy Wakeman: Drama researcher and author who will share practical methods to eliminate workplace drama and foster resilience.
  • Hamza Khan: Award-winning entrepreneur and keynote speaker, inspiring audiences with actionable strategies for success.
Joining these luminaries are:
  • Alex Banayan: The youngest bestselling author in American history, leading a workshop on overcoming personal and professional barriers.
  • Jacob Morgan: A futurist and leadership expert who will inspire attendees to create future-ready organizations.
  • Dr. Tash Eurich: Organizational psychologist and New York Times bestselling author, sharing 20+ years of expertise in coaching executives.

Why Attend Workhuman Live 2025?

The ultimate gathering to tackle work's biggest challenges, Workhuman Live is not just a conference. Attendees will have the opportunity to interact with industry leaders, explore innovative ideas, and come away with actionable strategies for the future of work. The addition of Trevor Noah elevates this event, making it a must-do opportunity.

Register Now for Workhuman Live 2025

Don't miss the opportunity to learn from Trevor Noah and other industry luminaries. To find out more about the full agenda and register, go to www.workhumanlive.com. To get 20% off general admission tickets, use the code WHL25-TREVOR. Attending Workhuman Live 2025 will allow you to reimagine the future of work. Participate in this transformative experience!
